rationale: Glucose depleted; switching to lactate and amino acid fermentation (cysteine, proline, alanine) as primary carbon and nitrogen sources. Lactate degradation plus Stickland-type amino acid fermentation yields acetate, butyrate, formate, H₂, CO₂, and H₂S. Carbon budget: 37 mmol in (lactate 12, cysteine 9, proline 10, alanine 6) covers 13.3 mmol biomass + ~23.7 mmol products. Nitrogen: 9 mmol in covers 3.5 mmol biomass cost. Growth rate 0.35 /h reflects continued substrate limitation and product accumulation.
